notes: §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.2 (added by Amendment 1) prints one format: the required word FUNCTION, function-name-1, an optional parenthesized list of one or more argument-1 ("[ ( { argument-1 } ... ) ]") and an optional reference-modifier. The grammar rule functionCall parses it and IntrinsicBinder.BindIntrinsic binds it at every edition; what 2023 adds is refused at --std 85 by edition arms, probed: the word FUNCTION omitted (COBOL1543 from BindIntrinsic for LENGTH, RANDOM and SUM, whose remedy text names the 2002 REPOSITORY entry; KeywordOmittedFunction needs a REPOSITORY entry, itself COBOL0900 at 85, so UPPER-CASE (X) is an undefined name), a function later than the 1989 module (COBOL1502 from BindFunctionResult's IntroducedIn window: PI, E, TRIM), OMITTED (COBOL1544), and a second reference modifier (COBOL1630, FinishIntrinsic); ResultRefMod applies the one modifier. PARTIAL for one arm: the parenthesized list may be EMPTY at 85. functionCall writes the list as optional inside the parentheses (FNARG_LPAREN functionArgList? FNARG_RPAREN) and BindIntrinsic binds an empty list at every edition with no edition test, so FUNCTION RANDOM () and FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE () compile and run at --std 85, where the 1985 braces require an argument once the parentheses are written (§1985:IV.2.1.4). The empty list is the 2023 form (the change record: 2023 brackets the item inside the parentheses). The witness runs UPPER-CASE with and without a modifier, MAX (3 7 5) and CURRENT-DATE (1:4); also probed right at 85: comma-separated arguments, a nested function argument, E (ALL), RANDOM with and without (1), WHEN-COMPILED (1:2).

next.reason: §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.2 (added by Amendment 1, X3.23a-1989; Errata C95) prints one format: the required word FUNCTION, "function-name-1", an optional parenthesized list of one or more argument-1, and an optional reference-modifier. §2023:8.4.3.2.2 widens it: FUNCTION is in brackets (§2023:8.4.3.2.3 SR2: "the word FUNCTION may be omitted from the function-identifier; otherwise the word FUNCTION is required"); the name is one of "function-pointer-name-1", "function-prototype-name-1" or "intrinsic-function-name-1" where 1985 has only an intrinsic function-name; each argument position may be the word "OMITTED"; and the item inside the parentheses is bracketed, so the list may be empty (the NOTE at §2023:8.4.3.2.3 SR6 writes FUNCTION RANDOM ()). The reference-modifier leaves this format: 2023 carries it as identifier Format 3, "identifier-1 reference-modifier-1" (§2023:8.4.3.1.2), whose identifier-1 may be a function-identifier, with the modifier's own format at §2023:8.4.3.3.2 ("leftmost-position" : length). Every function-identifier 1985 accepts is still accepted; 2023 accepts forms 1985 refuses.
